harbor_square.name: Central Harbor Square
harbor_square.description: A sunlit square paved with cobblestone overlooking the royal harbor. In the center stands the statue of Arvendale's founder. Captain Eliza watches over the docks.

market_street.name: Market Street
market_street.description: A lively avenue lined with colorful merchant awnings and bustling stalls. To the west rings the hammer of the Blacksmith's Forge, while a Town Guide and a Guild Scout chat near the fountain.

blacksmith_forge.name: Royal Blacksmith Forge
blacksmith_forge.description: Heat radiates from a roaring stone furnace. Newly forged blades and reinforced shields rest beside the anvil.

apothecary.name: Apothecary Shop
apothecary.description: Sunlight streams through stained glass onto shelves of red healing elixirs, dried roots, and herbal remedies.

tavern.name: The Salty Siren Tavern
tavern.description: A cozy harbor inn filled with warm hearthlight, the aroma of fresh bread, and bottles of aged port wine.

docks.name: The Great Pier
docks.description: Weathered timber planks creak above turquoise harbor waters. The imposing Dock Warden stands guard near the entrance to the eastern warehouse.

warehouse.name: Abandoned Warehouse
warehouse.description: A shadowy storehouse at the edge of the pier filled with stolen royal cargo. A Shadow Smuggler guards a desk with sealed documents. Reports about missing ships lie among the papers.

town_gate.name: North Town Gate
town_gate.description: Massive iron-bound stone gates adorned with blue and gold banners, marking the boundary between the city and the northern forest.

forest_edge.name: Whispering Forest Edge
forest_edge.description: Golden sunbeams filter through ancient pines onto mossy stones where rare medicinal herbs grow. A ferocious Dire Wolf prowls nearby.

item.rope.name: Hempen Rope
item.rope.description: A strong coil of braided sailors' rope.

item.iron_sword.name: Iron Sword
item.iron_sword.description: A sturdy iron blade forged by Master Borin. Grants a combat attack bonus when held.

item.oak_shield.name: Oak Shield
item.oak_shield.description: A heavy oak shield reinforced with iron bands. Grants a defense bonus in combat.

item.herbs.name: Healing Herbs
item.herbs.description: Fragrant medicinal herbs gathered from the Whispering Forest for the people of Arvendale.

item.compromise_letter.name: Incriminating Letter
item.compromise_letter.description: A sealed letter containing evidence of the harbor smuggling operation. Bring it to Captain Eliza.

item.missing_ships_report.name: Missing Ships Report
item.missing_ships_report.description: A report containing clues about vessels that disappeared from the royal harbor. Bring it to Captain Eliza.

item.gold_coins.name: Purse of Gold Coins
item.gold_coins.description: A purse of gold coins awarded for completing an important investigation.

item.healing_potion.name: Healing Elixir
item.healing_potion.description: A bright crimson alchemical elixir that restores health points after battle.

item.bread.name: Fresh Bread
item.bread.description: A warm, crusty loaf baked this morning at The Salty Siren Tavern.

item.wine.name: Harbor Vintage Wine
item.wine.description: A bottle of rich spiced wine served to sailors at The Salty Siren.

item.lantern.name: Brass Lantern
item.lantern.description: A polished brass oil lantern that illuminates dark storehouses.

item.pouch.name: Leather Pouch
item.pouch.description: A sturdy leather belt pouch dropped near the market stalls.
